crossRefs.note: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs…
The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

parallels.note: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Mizzah
people.line: A grandson of Esau and a chief of Edom.

people.name: Nahath
people.line: A descendant of Esau, a chief of Edom.

people.name: Reuel
people.line: Son of Esau and Basemath, a chief of Edom

people.name: Shammah
people.line: Son of Reuel, grandson of Esau

people.name: Zerah
people.line: Son of Reuel, grandson of Esau

translations.web: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
translations.bsb: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
translations.kjv: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau's wife.
translations.asv: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Basemath, Esau's wife.
